preconditions.description: The width of the picture is between 1 and 20.
The height of the picture is between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: A and B are divisible by X and Y respectively
preconditions.description: The picture can be divided into pieces of size X by Y.

postconditions.description: The number of good puzzles is positive.
The minimal piece width is between 1 and the width of the picture.
The minimal piece height is between 1 and the height of the picture.
The area of the smallest piece is less than or equal to the area of the whole picture.

postconditions.expression: all(X * Y <= A * B for X, Y in good_puzzles)
postconditions.description: All good puzzles have sizes that are possible given the picture dimensions.

postconditions.expression: all(X * Y == minimal_piece_width * minimal_piece_height for X, Y in good_puzzles if X * Y == minimal_piece_width * minimal_piece_height)
postconditions.description: The smallest area among all good puzzles is the area of the smallest piece.

postconditions.expression: all(X * Y == minimal_piece_width * minimal_piece_height and (X <= minimal_piece_width or (X == minimal_piece_width and Y < minimal_piece_height)) for X, Y in good_puzzles if X * Y == minimal_piece_width * minimal_piece_height)
postconditions.description: If there are multiple pieces with the same area, the one with the smaller width is chosen.
